text:
rachel: deploybot paused the release window. CI publish step failing with cache-stamp rotation -> artifact index mismatch. Holding promotion.
dan: ugh. which job?
qa-lead: postsubmit build 7321 failed verify: expected index stamp v12 but registry returned v9 for image docker.redwood/inference:2026-04-01-0f1e2d.
infra: we rotated the cache index stamps during a compact job last night. Looks like some runners retained old stamp and published against stale index.
deploy-bot: automated: promotion halted at step=artifact-verify; last-known-good=docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-31-9c8b7a. Manual continue: `deploybot promote --to-image 9c8b7a --force --reason "pin-after-cache-stamp-mismatch"`
pm-hope: PMs asking whether to delay. Options: 1) pin to last-known-good and proceed (fast), 2) rebuild all artifacts under the new stamp (longer, safer).
rachel: given customer commitments, pin + follow-up postmortem. We'll require extra smoke and a short audit of registry entries.
dan: agree. infra, can you add a guard in the CI publish step to assert stamp parity before finalize?
infra: on it. adding stamp-check preflight and a rollback for compact if stamp drift detected. Opening INF-1250.
deploy-bot: note: use `deploybot promote --to-image 9c8b7a --reason "manual-pin-due-to-index-stamp-drift"` to continue.
qa-lead: i'll run targeted smoke and the critical e2e subset once pinned.
pm-hope: i'll update release notes: "prod cut pinned to previous stable image 9c8b7a due to registry index stamp rotation causing artifact verify failures; follow-ups: INF-1250, CI preflight stamp check."
rachel: can someone run the promote and start canary?
dan: running `deploybot promote --to-image 9c8b7a --reason \"pin-for-release-window\"` now.
deploy-bot: Promotion started. canary rollout to staging at 10%. health checks watching.
infra: stamp preflight change is ready in staging; rolling to prod after verification.
deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded in staging. Prod promotion requires manual approval.
qa-lead: smoke green. recommend prod approve once postmortem plan is set.
rachel: decision recorded: manual pin to last-known-good, postpone automated prod cut until INF-1250 fixes and postmortem. Closing thread.
